text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Tamamo Cross will be hosting a modest takoyaki party for three.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, listen up! It's all in the wrist! Ya gotta get the snappin' rhythm down!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You stick the pick in like this and… turn! Turn! Let 'em settle a sec, then pop 'em out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Last, just drizzle the secret sauce over 'em 'n boom! You've got a batch of my extra soft takoyaki!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! You're a genius, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That I am! If it's takoyaki you're after, I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you… I want you to make this takoyaki for me every morning!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's quite a tall order you're makin' there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, it's takoyaki—not your momma's miso soup.
choice_data_list: That just goes to show how impressed she is.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm happy that you're happy! And you, Trainer! Ya haven't even had one yet!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, eat up! They're pipin' hot in the middle, so watch ya don't go burnin' yer tongue!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Man, I just told ya to watch out! Here, have some ice-cold water.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmph?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Man, not you too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh I'm fine, I was just surprised… It's just so fluffy and gooey.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The juices have such a wonderful aroma… So this is how authentic takoyaki tastes…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hehe, flavor like this isn't easy to come by, huh? Now try one with some cod roe mayo!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I will! I could eat a hundred of these!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Done, and done! …You really are a bottomless pit, ya know that?
choice_data_list: They're so delicious I just can't stop!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… I think I have enough space for a thousand more!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: My arm's gonna fall off! But hey, glad to hear ya like 'em so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross is busily cooking away, but I haven't seen her eat a single takoyaki herself yet…
choice_data_list: Why don't you have some too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Nah, don't worry 'bout me! I'm havin' fun just makin' 'em!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Good food tastes best when it's shared with everyone. I'll just give you a couple of mine…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Here you… go… Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm good, honest! 'Sides, it's hard to take up your offer when you look so torn up about sharin' 'em!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I can't let you go hungry… Take the plate—oh no!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The takoyaki start rolling off the plate!
choice_data_list: We can't let them go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The takoyaki start rolling off the plate!
choice_data_list: We can't let them go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Just what I was thinkin'! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… Heh! Snagged it! Mmm yep, there's no beatin' my takoyaki!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A little takoyaki goes a long way! I'm not lettin' a single morsel of food go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Agreed. Tama might have beaten me this time, but the next ball is mine!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ooh, is that so? Looks like we got a race on the table here. But I'm warnin' ya, if we're doin' this, I'm winnin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, why don't we just eat 'em normally?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross's baffled cry echoes around the room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hit the deck, catching the takoyaki in my mouth before it hits the ground!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That's the spirit, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Catchin' it midair was a gutsy move!
choice_data_list: You put in so much effort making these. I couldn't let any go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Man, ya sure know how to butter me up… but it's hard to take ya serious when there's sauce all over your mug.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No, not there! Man, look at you, smearing food all over your face like a toddler.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll just wipe it off for ya… Okay, nice 'n clean!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, w-wait no, sorry! I'm so used to my siblings 'n all…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're pretty maternal, huh, Tama…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez. Whaddya expect when I gotta babysit you two all the—wait, who're you callin' Mom?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross's exasperated cry echoes around the room.
